turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Dana, how can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: my internet is completely down since this morning can you fix it

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: OK, I can help with that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm checking for an outage in your area. There is no known outage. Please unplug your modem, wait 30 seconds, then plug it back in.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: ok done lights are back but still no internet

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: OK. Next, check that the coaxial cable at the back of the modem is screwed in tight.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: ok did that yeah its working now thanks

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Glad your internet is back.
